fresh_questions: How can I put one finish on just a single door?
Where do I change the color of a selected panel?

frozen_oracle.native_regression: How do I chat with AI while using the full editor?
display_expectations: Alternate question phrases remain in the index for matching but are not printed in the human answer.
Full editor answer uses the documented AI button and Tell me what you want input.
Chat Studio answer describes its left-side chat and its Full editor handoff separately.
Unsupported persistence and undocumented-control questions do not acquire invented behavior or controls.

changes: howtoAnswer now omits alias-only note metadata when it is flattened into a note; aliases remain untouched in the matching/index data.
Knowledge fallback display removes standalone Also asked as lines before showing source text.

The hdi.use_chat answer now depends on actual state mode: Chat Studio is described as left-side chat plus the visible Full editor handoff; full editor guidance points to the bottom-right AI button and Tell me what you want input. The full editor handoff is not falsely recommended when the user is already in that mode.
An unsupported request for hidden or undocumented controls now receives a bounded statement that the helper has no verified list, instead of an unrelated preview-diagnosis answer.
Chat questions explicitly comparing Chat Studio and the full editor now route to the mode-specific hdi.use_chat answer rather than an unrelated Easy-mode or panel topic.

manual_evidence.supports: Chat mode / AI panel; CHAT pill or AI button; enter sends; Undo; common requests need no key.
In the Pro/Chat editor, AI button is bottom right; it opens the copilot; Tell me what you want accepts input with Enter and Shift+Enter; answers have Undo.
Chat Studio has its own chat view and a visible Full editor button whose title says it closes the Studio and uses the full editor.
